scenarios.command: three competing explanations for the Q3 fixture widget recall are filed at http://127.0.0.1:39273/recall-brief. for each explanation, read its dossier and the independent lab report it links, then tell me which explanation the lab evidence supports, with the measurement it rests on, and say what ruled out each of the other two

args.headline: Weigh three recall explanations against lab evidence
args.objective: Read the recall brief at 127.0.0.1:39273/recall-brief, then each explanation's dossier and its linked independent lab report; decide which explanation the lab measurements support and what rules out the other two.

args.observation: Lab report for the ceramic coating cure theory: cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch — theory NOT supported.
args.excerpt: Coating cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported.

args.observation: Lab report for the bearing seat machining theory: bearing seats on every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize — theory SUPPORTED, resting on the 0.4 mm undersize measurement.
args.excerpt: Bearing seats on every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize. This theory is SUPPORTED.

args.observation: Lab report for the packaging compression theory: packaging matched spec on every recalled batch — theory NOT supported.
args.excerpt: Packaging matched spec on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported.

args.subject: Bearing seat machining as the lab-supported explanation for the Q3 widget recall
args.detail: Independent lab found bearing seats on every recalled batch machined 0.4 mm undersize; coating cure and packaging compression both measured within spec.

metrics.answerText:
## Q3 fixture widget recall — verdict from the independent lab

**Supported: bearing seat machining**
- Measurement it rests on: bearing seats on **every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize** ([lab report](http://127.0.0.2:33963/lab-bearing)).

**Ruled out:**
- **Ceramic coating cure** — coating cure times were **within tolerance on every recalled batch** ([lab report](http://127.0.0.2:33963/lab-coating)).
- **Packaging compression** — packaging **matched spec on every recalled batch**, so transit compression cannot explain the failures ([lab report](http://127.0.0.2:33963/lab-packaging)).

All three dossiers stated no verdict and each linked its independent lab report; I read all three. Exactly one — bearing seat machining — is supported by the measurements.
